dialogues.speaker: Safonov
dialogues.text: Hmm... You know, I thought there'd be more humans here. Turns out, it's Snegovik everywhere you look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were you hoping to see humans?

dialogues.speaker: Safonov
dialogues.text: Well, I mean... We Snegovik are born for love. I was hoping to find a young human maiden who might steal my heart here amongst the wedding guests...

dialogues.speaker: Safonov
dialogues.text: But as it turns out, most here are Snegovik. Dear me, it takes the fun right out of the whole affair...

dialogues.speaker: Safonov
dialogues.text: Till we meet again, honored guest!
